title: Builds, Builders and Buildings
description: This project adds blocks to the game to help all builders. If you have an idea, request, or criticism, we are willing to listen and work accordingly.
body:
Welcome to our first mod. We observed a problematic situation in modding. While many try to fix this issue, such as Opaleqs Builders Palette, many of them fall short in certain regards. We aim not to fall short

Our mission is to help make a one-size-fits-all mod that can help with building almost anything for any builder, from industrial blocks to rustic blocks. We want to give back to our community. Obviously, in the mod's current state its just a few number and equation sign blocks, but we will be improving soon, we will be adding a lot to the pack to essentially overhaul Minecraft with mods


Contact us on our Discord here: https://discord.gg/Y9j8yKan7E
